svg.title: URTC-WEB-STUDIO architecture
svg.desc: URTC-WEB-STUDIO is a React and Vite single-page app. Flasher Studio and Tester Studio send and receive the real CAN frames of the URTC protocol through a Web Serial SLCAN adapter, with the frames validated in both directions; the sandbox tabs transmit nothing. Everything is verified by unit tests and end-to-end checks against a modelled board; nothing has been run against a real adapter or board.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: A browser tab that talks to a URTC board through a USB-CAN adapter with Web Serial, plus offline sandbox tabs to explore the 25 tools.
